input.quote: 10.3 Assignment. This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 is a bare successors-and-assigns clause: it is silent on consent standards, so it neither expressly confirms our right to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets, nor restricts HDI from assigning the development and hosting obligations, including to a competitor of ours. No change-of-control provision appears anywhere in the Agreement, and termination (Sections 2/2.x, p0024–p0026) is notice-based, so there is no Vendor exit or re-pricing trigger on our change of control (no walk-away issue). The gap is the missing asymmetric allocation required by the preferred position, so we add the Customer affiliate/successor carve-out, a consent requirement (not unreasonably withheld) with a no-competitor limit on HDI's assignment, and express confirmation that our change of control is not an assignment and gives HDI no termination or re-pricing right.

proposal.summary: Add Customer affiliate/successor assignment carve-out, consent restriction on HDI's assignment (no competitors), and confirm no HDI rights on Company change of control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 only addresses successors and assigns generally, so it neither confirms our right to assign to an affiliate or M&A successor nor stops HDI from assigning the hosting services to a competitor of ours. We have added the customary carve-out for our affiliates and successors, a consent requirement (not unreasonably withheld) on HDI's side with no assignment to our competitors, and confirmation that a change of control of the Company gives HDI no termination or re-pricing right; if preferred, we can accept a mutual notice-based successor right with consent not unreasonably withheld for other assignments.

ops.text: The Company may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without HDI's consent, to any affiliate of the Company or to any successor in interest by way of merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or of the business to which this Agreement relates. HDI may not assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the Company's prior written consent (which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of the Company. No change of control of the Company shall constitute an assignment requiring HDI's consent or give HDI any right to terminate, suspend, re-price or otherwise modify this Agreement.
